S.subject: A warm multigenerational Tamil family celebrating Christmas together at home, including grandparents, parents, young adults, and children. Women wear elegant silk sarees and traditional sarees, men wear veshti with shirts or traditional festive clothing, and children wear colorful Indian outfits. The family is gathered naturally together, sharing food, exchanging gifts, talking, laughing, and celebrating with genuine affection.

C.composition: A long, wide cinematic interior shot showing several connected areas of a traditional Tamil home in one continuous frame. The main living room is the focal area, with the family gathered naturally around a modest beautifully decorated Christmas tree. The frame extends into the dining area, traditional kitchen, entrance space, and a visible corridor or inner courtyard. Use deep architectural perspective, natural sightlines, layered foreground and background, and a spacious documentary-style composition. The home itself should be visually important, not just the Christmas decorations.
